{{Quote|Have no fear, Colonel Maldrod&hellip;all is in readiness. Our forces will be ready to sweep to the far side of the village, where our bulk cruisers will pick them up, for transport to Kulthis.|Darth Vader|<ref name="annual3" />}}
'''Maldrod''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Maldrod was assigned to the [[Belderone system/Legends|Belderone system]], working underneath the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Andrid]] in an effort to snuff out growing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sentiment on [[Kulthis]]. When Vader personally [[Death/Legends|executed]] Andrid for insubordination, the Sith Lord tapped Maldrod to travel to [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]] with him and personally oversee the mobilization of Imperial forces to strike at Kulthis. Maldrod was present at the ensuing [[Battle of Belderone (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] on Belderone, when a Rebel force directly attacked an Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] factory on the planet, a Rebel victory.<ref name="annual3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maldrod appeared in [[Star Wars Annual (1977) 3|''Star Wars Annual'' (1977) 3]], written by [[Mary Jo Duffy]], illustrated by [[Klaus Janson]] and released in [[1983]].<ref name="annual3" />
